fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the upcoming October 27 election and debate over an $800,000 auditorium/convention hall for Miami; discussion of municipal welfare relief administered through grocery orders and criticism of a welfare-board store; commentary on pardons and criminal justice in Florida; and coverage of local business and civic matters including the Homestead bank situation and power-utility issues. Also features society-style columns, sports/boxing notes, and entertainment listings for Miami and Miami Beach venues.
